scope: Actual pinned free Redirection exact/capture redirects, published slug monitoring and local 404 logging. Native independent workflow; intentional syntax/query/privacy and graph-scope differences. No paid-plugin or full-PCRE parity.

free_plugin.logging_configuration: IP logging disabled; no reference request payload or client metadata exported.

differences: Native whole-path Rust regex rejects PCRE lookaround/backreferences and unanchored partial replacements.
Native query strings are discarded and rules cannot target external origins or reserved workflows.
Native reports aggregate admitted public paths without exporting client/header/query data; the free reference uses its own per-request log model.
Native graph covers declared anonymous publications/language landings; external/client/query expansion is not performed.
